text.p: Indonesian brokerage firm PT Lippo Securities said on Thursday it expected a "satisfying" 1996 net profit.
Shares of Lippo Securities have made strong gains in active trading in the past several days on market talk of possible higher-than-expected 1996 financial results.
Lippo was up 100 rupiah to 2,325 rupiah, with around three million shares traded after two hours of trading on Thursday. This compared with a closing price of 2,075 rupiah last Friday.
"I have heard the market talk (of possible better-than-expected 1996 net profits), it seems that the figures tend to be satisfying," one Lippo Securities official told Reuters.
The official declined to give further details.
Lippo posted a net profit of 26.12 billion rupiah in the first nine months of 1996 against 8.52 billion rupiah in the same period of 1995. Its 1995 full-year net profit was 14.1 billion rupiah.
It had forecast pre-tax profit of 32.3 billion rupiah in 1996 before a restructuring of the financial arms of the Lippo Group last September.
